suite: the model drawn alone and led (the end-stop model's parts only, a leader per placed node)
expect_red: [real] a part selected is selected on all four surfaces: its rows, dots, bars, container and bracket wear the accent, the interfaces it touches the fainter accent, the folds down to every lit row open, and in the scene its bound faces are overlaid harder than the part, which keeps its resting look

mutations.contract: A selected part's container and bracket wear the accent.
mutations.note: Declared by handoff hover_and_select_light_the_same_things_on_all_four_surfaces_and_nothing_goes_opaque (rule 3: a part's container is selectable, and shows it). No container or bracket is ever marked.
mutations.find:
var tier = selectedTier(ctx, kind, id);
    return tier === VA.FOCUS_TIERS.own ? " " + cls + "--selected"
mutations.replace:
var tier = null;
    return tier === VA.FOCUS_TIERS.own ? " " + cls + "--selected"
